summary: Under ADR-0096 section A, a local runner (current-composition-local.py) executes the typed current-composition plan on delivered source in a fresh private root with a closed environment, no credential and no shared destination: build the typed owner, fetch the exact public template and Rendering archives by typed SHA-256, run the existing current-source-stage, then list and run the nine typed cases per Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with workers 1, retries 0 and no skip or flake. It needs no Root runtime admission and does not open the held hosted route (ADMISSION=None, literal-false receiver). The first real execution of the held PR767 source exposed two defects that its pure controls could not: `dotnet new ... --package FS.GG.Workspace.Template` is not an option of the shipped SDK (fake-dotnet control asserted the flag), and the opt-in command-outcome specs register no case unless FsGgExternalReferenceCandidate reaches the separate Playwright process (the stage exports it for the build only), so the listing held 5 of 9 identities. Both are repaired with controls that fail on the old behavior; browser_environment(plan) now derives the flags from the typed selection for the managed route and the runner. Firefox and WebKit need Ubuntu 24.04 shared libraries absent on the Arch development host; the browser phase runs in a host-libraries image with no network and bind-mounted Node, .NET, receiver and browsers. Results are bound to head and tree in the delivery record, not here. This is development verification only: producer-custody readback stays reference-only, localSaved stays synthetic in-memory, and durable product save, AT (#4817), hosted original-operation, installed or published acceptance and whole #4818 remain separate. It does not change the older record's statement that no case ran in the PR767 source window; both are retained.
title: Typed DOM composition cases run locally under ADR-0096 and exposed two held-source defects
